text: This notice is issued for the purpose of recruiting a diligent student assistant for Professor Smith's research project on campus sports activities.
The relevant details are as follows.
In the first place, the selected assistant will be responsible for collecting survey data and helping organize interviews on students' exercise habits.
In the second place, applicants are expected to possess strong teamwork spirit, basic data analysis skills, and a keen interest in campus sports.
Not only can this position enrich your research experience, but it also offers a valuable chance to work closely with a distinguished scholar.
Those interested should send a resume to sports_research@university.edu.cn before January 5.
Your active application is warmly welcomed!
